description: This file implements the ItemPage component for an admin UI, including functions for item viewing, editing, deletion, and handling GraphQL interactions in a React/Next.js environment.

methods.name: useEventCallback
methods.description: Creates a stable callback that always refers to the latest version of the input callback, ensuring proper reference handling within React hooks.

methods.name: DeleteButton
methods.description: A React component that renders a delete button with confirmation dialog and error handling for deleting an item.

methods.name: ItemNotFound
methods.description: A React component that displays a styled message when an item is not found.

methods.name: ResetButton
methods.description: A React component that provides a reset button with confirmation dialog to discard changes.

methods.name: ItemForm
methods.description: A React component that renders a form for editing an item, handling validation, saving, and error display.

methods.name: getItemPage
methods.description: Function that returns the ItemPage React component; serves as a page entry point.

methods.name: ItemPage
methods.description: Main React component for displaying, editing, and managing an individual item, including loading state, error handling, and actions.
